name: Muffling Headphones
text: Affinity: 2–5. When you play this card, aces count as twos for this trick.
archetypes: Nil Guard, Blind Bidder; splash Nil Champion, Contract Attacker
decision: When to play it: under a nil partner's forced ace, or into a trick an opponent's ace would win.
opponent: Visible when played; it costs an ace at most one trick a round, and later players in the trick see it before choosing.
aiNote: Play it into a trick where your nil partner must follow with an ace, or where an opponent's ace is winning and you can follow suit.
rationale: The low-card affinity keeps it off your own aces. "Count as twos" rather than "can't win" so every trick keeps a winner (a lone led ace still wins as a two); a trump ace still beats non-trump cards.
